# `oeds.core.log_utils`

Package version: `2.2.0`

Configure Python logging for Databricks workloads.

## Import

```python
import oeds.core.log_utils as log_utils
```

## Functions

### `setup_logger`

```python
setup_logger(*, level: str='INFO', fmt: Optional[str]='%(asctime)s | %(levelname)-8s | %(name)s | %(message)s', datefmt: Optional[str]='%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') -> None
```

Configure the root logger without removing existing handlers.

The root level is set to ``level``; an unrecognized name falls back to
``INFO``. A stream handler is added only when the root logger has no
handlers. When both format arguments are truthy, the formatter is applied
to every handler that accepts it. The ``py4j`` logger is always set to
``WARNING``.

Args:
    level: Logging level name for the root logger.
    fmt: Log record format. Formatting is skipped when this value or
        ``datefmt`` is falsy.
    datefmt: Timestamp format. Formatting is skipped when this value or
        ``fmt`` is falsy.

Returns:
    None. Global logging configuration is changed as a side effect.

### `get_logger`

```python
get_logger(name: Optional[str]=None) -> logging.Logger
```

Return a named logger.

Args:
    name: Logger name to retrieve.

Returns:
    Logger registered under ``name``.

Raises:
    ValueError: If ``name`` is not provided.
